topic.title: Matchup data: ~15k self-play games between the 4 sample decks

messages.content:
I ran the four sample rule-based agents (each with its sample deck) against each other locally on the cabt engine — round-robin, first/second player alternated, ~2.5k games per matchup (15,225 total, 0 errors).

Standings

Deck Win rate W–L
Mega Lucario ex 60.4% 4600–3011
Dragapult ex 55.6% 4232–3382
Iono 43.8% 3336–4277
Mega Abomasnow ex 40.2% 3057–4555

Matchup matrix

Cell = row deck's win rate vs column deck.

↓ vs → Mega Lucario Dragapult Iono Mega Abomasnow
Mega Lucario — 50% 78% 52%
Dragapult 50% — 64% 53%
Iono 22% 36% — 74%
Mega Abomasnow 48% 47% 26% —

Takeaways

  • Lucario and Dragapult are the top tier, but ~50/50 head-to-head — Lucario only leads overall by beating Iono harder (78% vs 64%).
  • Clear rock-paper-scissors element: every deck loses to the field but Iono crushes Abomasnow 74%.
  • First-player win rate is 51.5% — a small but real going-first edge.

Numbers are from the sample agents as-is, so they reflect deck + baseline policy together, not deck ceiling. Curious if others see the same ordering.
